title: MiSTiQ: MicroScaling Trellis Quantization for Extreme KV Cache Compression
abstract: arXiv:2611.21216v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) increasingly support longer contexts and serve more concurrent requests, increasing both sequence lengths and batch sizes. Both trends increase KV-cache size and memory traffic during inference. KV-cache quantization reduces these costs, with recent approaches using codebook-based vector quantization to achieve extremely low bit widths. However, hardware constraints limit codebook size, and most methods reconstruct the cache in higher-precision floating-point formats for attention, limiting the computational benefits of quantization. To address these limitations, we introduce MiSTiQ, a drop-in replacement for codebook-based vector quantizers that combines trellis-coded storage with microscaling (MX) formats for low-precision computation. translated_title: MiSTiQ：面向极致KV缓存压缩的微缩放格型量化
translated_abstract: 现代大语言模型（LLM）日益支持更长的上下文并服务更多并发请求，使得序列长度和批处理规模都不断增加。这两种趋势都增大了推理过程中的KV缓存大小和内存流量。KV缓存量化可以降低这些开销，最近的方法使用基于码本的向量量化来实现极低的比特宽度。然而，硬件约束限制了码本的大小，且大多数方法在注意力计算中以更高精度的浮点格式重建缓存，限制了量化带来的计算收益。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了MiSTiQ，它是基于码本的向量量化器的即插即用替代方案，将格型编码存储与微缩放（MX）格式相结合以实现低精度计算。我们将格型量化与束搜索相结合，在无需大码本的情况下于大重建空间中对KV缓存进行编码。为了支持MX计算，我们推导了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出MiSTiQ，将格型编码存储与束搜索相结合、并采用微缩放（MX）低精度格式，作为码本向量量化器的即插即用替代方案，在无需大码本的情况下实现KV缓存的极致压缩并保留低精度计算收益。
en_tdlr: MiSTiQ combines trellis-coded storage with beam search and microscaling (MX) formats as a drop-in replacement for codebook-based vector quantizers, achieving extreme KV cache compression without large codebooks while enabling low-precision computation.
